task: Edit this 75–110-word food-history note using the original fictional notebook and marginal addition. input: The 1930 recipe always used oats, and every household followed it without variation. Its author wrote the later margin note herself: “Use oats if barley runs out.” This confirms that barley was never part of the original dish and that the substitution happened every time.
